subject: Slide (Page) number in markdown presentation doc

messages.author: a146dded6483c593
messages.subject: Slide (Page) number in markdown presentation doc
parts:
I am writing a R presentation using Rstudio and would like to include a page (slide) number at the bottom of each page except the title page.

Is this possible?

Regards

Ross

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Slide (Page) number in markdown presentation doc
parts:
You are recommended to try rmarkdown (i.e. R Markdown v2), which
supports ioslides2012, and you will have page numbers, e.g.
https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/15335397/slides/Seattle-useR-2014-Yihui-Xie.html

The rmarkdown package is still under development, but it is actually
very usable now: http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com/

Regards,
Yihui
